definitions.explanation: To a great extent or degree. Used to emphasize the magnitude of something.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}いに⟦{助|たす}かりました→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|おお}いに⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}った→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: What he said was very useful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大|おお}いに⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I greatly enjoyed this trip, so I want to go again next year.

notes:
{大|おお}いに is a formal adverb meaning greatly or very much.

POSITION: Usually placed before the verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大|おお}いに⟦{役立|やくだ}つ→役立つ：03168_yakudatsu⟧ (be very useful)
- {大|おお}いに⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (enjoy greatly)
- {大|おお}いに⟦{賛成|さんせい}する→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧ (strongly agree)
- {大|おお}いに⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧ (quite all right, perfectly fine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very (neutral)
- {大|おお}いに: greatly (formal, emphatic)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}に→非常に：01223_hijouni⟧: extremely (formal)
